description: The chart illustrates “Average Performance” values for several methods from the paper “Context-Informed Grounding Supervision,” shown as a set of vertical bars in a 3D-styled perspective. The category axis is along the horizontal direction at the base, with method names labeled (left to right) as “Self-RAG,” “FactTuneCInGS (w/),” and “CInGS,” with an additional leftmost bar whose label is not fully visible in the cropped image; the categories appear in the displayed left-to-right order rather than an explicitly stated sorting. The value axis is labeled “Average Performance” and uses a linear numeric scale with visible tick marks at approximately 10-unit intervals (e.g., 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60), extending to a little above 60. The leftmost visible bar is orange and reaches roughly the mid-to-high 50s; the “Self-RAG” bar is a light tan/khaki color and rises to around 60; the “FactTuneCInGS (w/)” bar is light green and is slightly above 60; the “CInGS” bar is dark blue and is the tallest, extending above the 60 tick toward the upper limit of the plotted range. No legend is shown, and there are no visible annotations, outlines, or other emphasis marks beyond the distinct bar colors and the 3D shading.
